technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is Java 17+ with Spring Framework 6.x / Spring Cloud Stream 4.x, consistent with the referenced framework baseline.

Build system uses Maven with a BOM (Bill of Materials) import approach for managing external library versions dynamically; documentation for U1 will be written in AsciiDoc/Markdown alongside the existing reference docs and published with the standard docs build.

Unit tests (U5, U6) will be implemented with JUnit 5 and Mockito, following the existing test conventions of the deployer SPI modules, with no requirement for live runtime infrastructure (heavy use of mocks/fakes).

Integration tests (U2, U3, U4) will be implemented with JUnit 5 plus Testcontainers/in-process SPI stubs where feasible, and will be wired into the existing CI pipeline as separate Maven profiles/Gradle tasks so they can run on demand or per environment.

For U7 (container shutdown failure with a jdbc->hdfs stream), the fix will target the application/context lifecycle: ensure the JDBC source poller, DataSource, and HDFS sink threads/executors are properly stopped and closed during context shutdown so the container JVM can terminate; a regression integration test reproducing the reported stream definition will be added.

For U8 (multiple binder connection factories), the design will extend the existing binder configuration model (e.g., BinderFactory/binder per-binding configuration) so each binding can reference a named binder configuration with its own connection factory, keeping full backward compatibility with the single-binder default behavior.
All changes follow the existing code style, and each story will go through the standard review and CI verification before merge.
assumptions: A single developer (the estimator) performs all work and is already familiar with the Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring Cloud Stream codebases and their build tooling.
Existing development environment, source repositories, and CI infrastructure are available and functional; no environment procurement time is included.

For integration tests, either lightweight test doubles or accessible test instances of Lattice, Cloud Foundry, and YARN are available; provisioning of production-grade external clusters is out of scope.

For U7, the referenced external issue (VESC-504) and stream definition provide enough information to reproduce the shutdown problem locally with an Oracle XE or equivalent JDBC test database substituted.

Effort estimates cover analysis, design, implementation, unit/integration testing, documentation, code review rework, and CI verification; they exclude release management, deployment to production, and ongoing maintenance.

'Enhance test coverage' means adding a meaningful, representative set of new tests for the main SPI code paths (deployment, undeployment, status, error handling), not achieving a fixed numerical coverage target.
The U8 feature is scoped to enabling multiple binder connection factories via configuration; no UI changes are required.
Estimates are most likely effort in work-hours, not elapsed calendar time.

activities.activity_name: Overall analysis, design and task breakdown
activities.activity_description: Review all eight user stories, inspect the relevant modules (deployer SPIs for Lattice/CF/YARN, spring-cloud-stream binder infrastructure, admin UI/container lifecycle), confirm reproduction of the U7 defect, and produce the technical design for U8 plus the test strategy for U2-U6.

Write reference documentation explaining how to use BOM templates to include and manage external libraries dynamically, including examples, version alignment guidance, and common pitfalls; verify code snippets against a sample project and integrate the page into the documentation build.

activities.activity_name: U2: Lattice SPI integration test coverage
activities.activity_description: Design and implement integration tests for the Lattice deployer SPI covering app deployment, undeployment, status reporting, scaling, and failure/timeout handling; wire the suite into the CI pipeline profile.

activities.activity_name: U3: Cloud Foundry SPI integration test coverage
activities.activity_description: Design and implement integration tests for the Cloud Foundry deployer SPI covering push, delete, status, environment variable/property propagation, and error handling; wire the suite into the CI pipeline profile.

activities.activity_name: U4: YARN SPI integration test coverage
activities.activity_description: Design and implement integration tests for the YARN deployer SPI covering application submission, kill/undeploy, status queries, and resource/error handling against a test or embedded YARN setup; wire the suite into the CI pipeline profile.

activities.activity_name: U5: Lattice SPI unit test coverage
activities.activity_description: Add unit tests (JUnit 5/Mockito) for the Lattice SPI implementation classes, covering request mapping, status translation, configuration handling, and exception paths.

activities.activity_name: U6: YARN SPI unit test coverage
activities.activity_description: Add unit tests (JUnit 5/Mockito) for the YARN SPI implementation classes, covering command construction, state translation, configuration handling, and exception paths.

activities.activity_name: U7: Fix container shutdown failure from Admin UI
activities.activity_description: Reproduce the shutdown hang with the reported jdbc->hdfs stream, diagnose the blocked lifecycle (e.g., lingering poller/executor threads or un-closed DataSource/HDFS resources), implement the shutdown/lifecycle fix, and add a regression test verifying the container stops cleanly.

activities.activity_name: U8: Multiple binder connection factories support
activities.activity_description: Implement support for more than one binder connection factory in spring-cloud-stream: extend binder configuration model, resolve named binder configurations per binding, manage lifecycle of multiple binder instances, maintain backward compatibility, and add unit and integration tests plus reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: CI pipeline integration for new test suites
activities.activity_description: Configure CI jobs/profiles so the new unit and integration suites (U2-U6) run in the pipeline with appropriate triggers, reporting, and failure notifications.

activities.activity_name: Integration, review rework and final verification
activities.activity_description: Address code review feedback, resolve merge/integration conflicts, run the full build and regression suites across affected modules, and perform final verification that all eight stories meet their acceptance intent.
